import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp,out=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
# find changed cells: input has scattered 0s (noise), output has 0s at some, 2s forming a rectangle
zeros=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==0]
print(zeros)
rows_of_z=sorted(set(i for i,j in zeros)); cols_of_z=sorted(set(j for i,j in zeros))
print(rows_of_z, cols_of_z)
# rectangle in output
twos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==2]
rmin=min(i for i,j in twos); rmax=max(i for i,j in twos); cmin=min(j for i,j in twos); cmax=max(j for i,j in twos)
print('rect',rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax)
print('zeros inside rect:',[(i,j) for i,j in zeros if rmin<=i<=rmax and cmin<=j<=cmax])
# corners of rect: which are zeros in input?
print('input at rect corners:',[inp[i][j] for i,j in [(rmin,cmin),(rmin,cmax),(rmax,cmin),(rmax,cmax)]])
# remaining zeros not in rect -> stay 0
print('zeros outside:',[(i,j) for i,j in zeros if not(rmin<=i<=rmax and cmin<=j<=cmax)], 'output there:',[out[i][j] for i,j in zeros if not(rmin<=i<=rmax and cmin<=j<=cmax)])
# where do 2s appear: rectangle border except where input is 0? check border cells where input!=0 but output==0
border=[(i,j) for i in range(rmin,rmax+1) for j in range(cmin,cmax+1) if i in(rmin,rmax) or j in(cmin,cmax)]
print('border cells with output 0:',[(i,j) for i,j in border if out[i][j]==0])
print('border cells with input 0:',[(i,j) for i,j in border if inp[i][j]==0])
# interior cells with 2?
print('interior 2s:',[(i,j) for i,j in twos if rmin<i<rmax and cmin<j<cmax])
